host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the server to. Leave empty to listen on all interfaces.

udp_port.description: UDP port for game traffic (e.g., player movement). If omitted, defaults to TCP port.

maxplayers.description: Maximum number of players allowed on the server simultaneously.

servername.description: Public name of the server shown in server browsers.

mapname.description: Base name of the map to load (e.g., 'cube' for cube.map).

rconpassword.description: Password for remote administration via RCON. Keep secret!

logfile.description: Path to server log file. Leave empty to disable file logging.

admins.description: List of SteamIDs (64-bit integers) with admin privileges.

items.description: Steam64 ID of an admin user.

bans.description: List of SteamIDs (64-bit integers) to ban from the server.

items.description: Steam64 ID of a banned user.

public.description: Broadcast server to public master lists: 0=no, 1=yes.
